label: Goptṛtve-Varaṇa Song Four
title: tumi sarveśvareśvara brajendra-kumāra
metaDescription: Goptṛtve-Varaṇa Song Four: (tumi sarveśvareśvara brajendra-kumāra) of Śaraṇāgati (‘Surrender’) written by Bhaktivinoda Ṭhākura in 1893. This songbook contains 50 songs detailing the six symptoms of surrender unto the lotus feet of Śrī Kṛṣṇa.

verses.translation: O youthful son of the King of Vraja, You are Lord of all lords. According to Your will, creation and destruction take place in the universe.
According to Your will Lord Brahmā creates, and according to Your will Lord Viṣnu maintains.
According to Your will Lord Śiva destroys, and according to Your will Māyā constructs the prison house of this world.
According to Your will the living beings take birth and die, and according to Your will they meet with prosperity and ruin, happiness and sorrow.

translit: tava icchā binā kichu korite nā pāre
verses.translation: The tiny soul bound up by Māyā vainly struggles in the fetters of worldly desire. Without Your sanction he is unable to do anything.
deva: तव इच्छा बिना किछु कोरिते ना पारे
bengali: তব ইচ্ছা বিনা কিছু কোরিতে না পারে

translit: tumi to’ rākhaka ār pālaka āmāra
tomāra caraṇa binā āśā nāhi āra
verses.translation: You are my only protector and maintainer. Except for Your lotus feet there is no other hope for me.
deva: तुमि तो’ राखक आर् पालक आमार
तोमार चरण बिना आशा नाहि आर
bengali: তুমি তো’ রাখক আর্ পালক আমার
তোমার চরণ বিনা আশা নাহি আর

verses.translation: No longer confident of my own strength and endeavor, I have become solely dependent on Your will.
Bhaktivinoda is most poor, and his pride has been leveled. Now in accordance with Your will he lives and dies.
